hardware: Windows, Intel A770 16GB, Xeon E5-2696 v4, 256GiB RAM
scope: Native DG2 caches a validated resident-allocation index per payload field. Explicit GPU values and compiler-captured GPU pointers share the helper. GPU range revalidated against the current allocation vector, fallback remains ordered linear. CPU translation still runs first. Separate aggregate pointer fields no longer overwrite the same argument-index hint; actual expert-pair ABI has six pointer fields in each of two struct arguments.
baseline: Previously adopted validated storage-index hint, single argument pack, local-ID payload reuse, fused expert activation and one owner handoff per pair; all three earlier non-adopted candidates absent

cpu_resident_benchmark.scope: 64-byte cross-thread payload, four GPU pointers as distinct args or one aggregate; explicit values or compiler captures; 8/32/128/512 allocations, one in four CPU-mapped at disjoint numeric addresses; same target allocations with changing interior offsets or alternating allocations. Actual pack_arguments with/without hints. One warm batch, seven retained batches of 32768. CPU only, no model throughput estimate.

adoption_criterion: Positive overall measured prefill and TTFT direction, exact outputs and numerical checks, no material case regression. User accepts positive gains below 1%; no 1% adoption hard gate.
isolation: Previous storage-hint runtime plus only per-payload-field resident hints, compiler capture GPU lookup integration and CPU checks; same owner/engine objects and math images. Current tree runtime separately built and GPU-checked. In-place payload and nested image maps absent; earlier per-argument granularity corrected.

checks.coverage: Interleaved hints, allocation growth/removal/clear/reorder, repeated hits, base/last-byte/end/zero/UINT64_MAX, exact packed bytes after index shifts, explicit/captured GPU/CPU/null pointers, CPU/GPU numeric-overlap priority, invalid range rejection; four pointers in one aggregate plus an implicit payload field, changing interior offsets and reordered allocations

model.protocol: Native validated per-payload-field resident-hint A0/B/A1: Short anchor, one Code2K/Prose2K warmup each (saved), two retained cycles each; no phase profiling
